helpSupport.subtitle: How can we help you?

helpSupport.faq1q: How do I add a place to favorites?
helpSupport.faq1a: To add a place to favorites, just tap the heart icon at the top right of the business page. The place will show up in your "My favorites" section.
helpSupport.faq2q: How do I write a review?
helpSupport.faq2a: Go to the business page, scroll to the reviews section and tap "Write a review". Pick your rating, write your comment and optionally add photos.
helpSupport.faq3q: Can I edit or delete my review?
helpSupport.faq3a: Yes. Go to your profile > My reviews. Tap the three dots on your review and choose "Edit" or "Delete".
helpSupport.faq4q: How do I change my profile photo?
helpSupport.faq4a: Go to your profile, tap your current photo and choose "Change photo". You can take a new one or pick one from your library.
helpSupport.faq5q: How do I turn off notifications?
helpSupport.faq5a: Go to your profile > Settings > Notifications. From there you can choose which kinds of notifications you want to receive.
helpSupport.faq6q: Can businesses reply to my reviews?
helpSupport.faq6a: Yes, business owners can reply to reviews. You'll get a notification when they reply to yours.
helpSupport.faq7q: How do I report inappropriate content?
helpSupport.faq7a: You can report reviews or inappropriate content by tapping the three-dot icon and choosing "Report". Our team will review it.
helpSupport.faq8a: Yes. Go to Profile > Account > Delete account. Deletion completes after 30 days, and you can cancel it by signing in again during that period.
